Company Description

Bosch Rexroth is one of the world’s leading providers of Drive and Control Technologies. Regardless of the motion task that customers face anywhere in the world, they will always find a Bosch Rexroth team with local experience and the appropriate know-how from more than 30 industries and all drive and control technologies. Our associates take on their customers’ challenges with passion and persistence until the right solution is found. This is what makes Bosch Rexroth a strong, reliable partner for Mobile Applications, Machinery Applications and Engineering and Factory Automation. As the Drive & Control Company, we develop, produce, and distribute our components and system solutions in over 80 countries.

Bosch Rexroth, dba HydraForce, Inc. offers one of the most comprehensive lines of high-quality hydraulic cartridge valves for the mobile and industrial equipment markets. We design and manufacture high performance valves that meet virtually any need encountered in machine design. Our cartridge valves are designed to fit a wide range of industry-common valve cavities. Our employees enjoy a fast-paced and challenging work environment that provides them with daily opportunities to Power Forward their careers. Job Description

The goal of HydraForce’s internship program is to develop future engineering resources for our organization while providing support to our Engineering groups. We structure the Engineering internship to allow candidates the opportunity to develop knowledge and skill-sets unique to our industry. Project tasks reflect an increasing level of technical complexity based on demonstrated proficiency and success on prior assignments. Although there is no guarantee of employment, it is our goal to have our interns fully capable of stepping into an entry-level engineering position upon graduation.

- Will assist in drafting assignments related to modeling and detail drawings

- Will learn to build prototypes in engineering
- Will work under guidance of design engineers in modeling 3D software, computational fluid dynamics, lab processes, and performance testing
- Will work with the team to develop Creo knowledge and skills
- Will learn to write technical reports on test findings wherever necessary
- Will support the team on statistical evaluations

Qualifications

- Committed to an Engineering undergraduate program
- Strong technical and problem-solving skills
- Basic proficiency in CAD modeling- Required
- Basic proficiency in MS Office Suite
- Knowledge of basic design practices
- Good written and oral communication and interpersonal skills
- Self-directed and motivated
- Majors:

Mechanical Engineering/Industrial Engineering

Additional Information

Indefinite U.S. work authorized individuals only. Future sponsorship for work authorization unavailable.

Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability / veterans

About Invesco

As one of the world’s leading independent global investment firms, Invesco is dedicated to rethinking possibilities for our clients. By delivering the combined power of our distinctive investment management capabilities, we provide a wide range of investment strategies and vehicles to our clients around the world. If you're looking for challenging work, intelligent colleagues, and exposure across a global footprint, come explore your potential at Invesco.

What’s in it for you?

Our people are at the very core of our success. Invesco employees get more out of life through our benefit and perk offerings including:

- Company networking events with other interns

- Peer Sponsor Program

- Leadership Connection series

- Virtual Lunch and Learns

- Invesco Cares volunteer events

- Complimentary coffee and snacks

- 401(K) matching of 100% up to the first 6% with a discretionary supplemental contribution

Job Description

Ready to make your mark in the world of data governance? Spend an unforgettable summer at Invesco alongside a select group of driven students. Our 9-week Summer Internship Program offers you the opportunity to work within our Corporate Functions Data Office, supporting initiatives that improve how data is governed, understood, and used across Finance, HR, Legal, Compliance, Internal Audit, and Risk.

As part of our Summer Internship Program cohort, you’ll participate in orientation, networking events, development workshops, and volunteer activities. You’ll work side by side with talented teams to learn about the business and contribute to meaningful initiatives that support data governance, data quality, reporting and process improvement across Corporate Functions.

If you enjoy analyzing data, improving processes, and turning information into clear insights, this role offers a unique opportunity to apply your skills in a dynamic, cross-functional environment. You’ll support initiatives that strengthen data governance, improve data quality, and help Corporate Functions use data more effectively.

Here’s the best part: crush your internship, and you could be eligible for a full-time offer to join our Early Career Program after graduation!

What You’ll Do

Support data governance initiatives across Corporate Functions:

- Help maintain inventories of critical data elements, data owners, data stewards, and key business processes

- Support preparation of materials for data governance meetings, working groups, and stakeholder updates

Assist with data quality and metadata activities:

- Analyze datasets to identify completeness, consistency, or accuracy issues

- Help document data definitions, business rules, lineage, and usage for key Corporate Function data

- Support data quality issue tracking by organizing findings, actions, owners, and status updates

Contribute to reporting, dashboards, and process improvement:

- Create or update dashboards, trackers, and summary reports to monitor data governance progress and key metrics

- Map current-state processes and help identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, or automate recurring activities

- Assist with preparing executive-ready summaries, presentations, and visual materials that communicate insights clearly

Support cross-functional projects and research:

- Research leading practices in data governance, data management, AI readiness, and regulatory expectations

- Partner with team members across Corporate Functions to gather information, validate documentation, and support project deliverables

- Assist with ad hoc projects related to data governance, data quality, master data, controls, or transformation initiatives

What You Get

- Broad Exposure to Corporate Functions Data Governance – Contribute to projects involving data governance, data quality, reporting, process improvement, and cross-functional initiatives across Corporate Functions

- Access to Finance Leadership – Connect with finance leaders throughout the summer and gain insight into how strategic decisions are made across the business

- Cross-Functional Projects & Ownership – Work on initiatives beyond your immediate team and take ownership of meaningful projects, with opportunities to see work through from concept to completion

- Career Launchpad – Build real-world skills and set the foundation for a future at Invesco and beyond

- Dedicated Mentorship – Get paired with a mentor to guide your experience and support your growth

- Intern Community – Collaborate, share ideas, and build lasting connections with fellow interns

- Pathway to Full-Time – Strong performance may lead to a full-time offer through our Early Career Program

Minimum Qualifications

- Currently enrolled in a bachelor’s degree program and graduating by summer of 2028

- All majors welcome, with an emphasis on Business, Finance, Accounting, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Computer Science, Economics, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field

- Demonstrated interest in data, analytics, data governance, or process improvement

- Must be able to work in one of Invesco’s offices where the program is available

- Must be authorized to work in the U.S. on a permanent basis. We do not offer any type of employment-based immigration sponsorship for this program. Invesco will not provide any assistance or sign any documentation in support of any other form of immigration sponsorship or benefit including optional practical training (OPT) or curricular practical training (CPT)

- Relocation and housing will not be included if an offer is extended

Preferred Qualifications

- Strong analytical, research, and problem-solving skills

- Ability to organize assignments and meet deadlines

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to summarize information clearly

- Interest in data governance, data quality, metadata, reporting, or process improvement

- Proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint and Excel

- Experience with or interest in data visualization, reporting, or analytics tools such as Power BI, Tableau, SQL, or similar

- Ability to work collaboratively across teams and functions

Full Time / Part Time

Full time

Worker Type

Student/Intern (Fixed Term)

Job Exempt (Yes / No)

No

Workplace Model

Pursuant to Invesco’s Workplace Policy, employees are expected to comply with the firm’s most current workplace model, which as of October 1, 2025, includes spending at least four full days each week working in an Invesco office. This reflects our belief that spending time together in the office helps us build stronger relationships, collaborate more easily, and support each other’s growth and development.

The above information on this description has been designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by employees within this role. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities and qualifications required of employees assigned to this job. The job holder may be required to perform other duties as deemed appropriate by their manager from time to time.

Invesco's culture of inclusivity and its commitment to diversity in the workplace are demonstrated through our people practices. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, creed, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital status, national origin, citizenship status, disability, age, or veteran status. Our equal opportunity employment efforts comply with all applicable U.S. state and federal laws governing non-discrimination in employment.

Job Description

This internship takes place onsite approximately 25 hours a week, in Farmington Hills, Michigan, the headquarters of Bosch North America, in the Information Security and Data Protection Region North America organization.

You will support a highly dynamic team in the functional areas of data protection compliance tracking, data reporting, and additional tasks as needed.

- Develop and maintain reporting dashboards and presentations using Power BI, Microsoft Excel, and PowerPoint.

2. Compliance, Privacy & Training Operations

- Coordinate workshops and training sessions, alignment meetings, and managing materials.

3. Project Coordination & Tool Support

- Conduct pre-work activities, including information gathering, task clustering, and progress tracking across project workstreams.
- Support the rollout and development of internal collaboration platforms or DPMS and ISMS tools (e.g. Viva Engage).

- Provide comprehensive administrative and operational support as needed.

- Proficient in Microsoft 365 (Focus on Power Bi, Excel)
- A minimum 3.0 GPA

- Must work at least 25 hours per week
- Valid U.S. driver's license

- Previous corporate experience or coursework or in data analytics, information security, business administration or risk management.
- Familiarity with information security, data protection, or privacy principles (ISMS, DPMS, ISO Standards, NIST or similar frameworks).
- Practical experience applying AI/generative AI tools to enhance workflows and reporting
- Professional proficiency in German (verbal and written) is a plus.

Additional Information

Indefinite U.S. work authorized individuals only. Future sponsorship for work authorization unavailable

Job Description:

Role Background

The Advanced Strategies & Research Technology Team in Fidelity’s Asset Management organization is an embedded team focused on unlocking the potential of new technologies, techniques and datasets, to assist our Investment Professionals in generating alpha for our investment products and customers.

The role is ideal for someone with an enterprise development background, with a strong technology, coding and data skills, looking to operate in a less constrained environment, as part of an accelerated development team.

The role is ideal for a skilled technical leader with strong design, collaboration and influencing skills.

Ideally the candidate is a full stack, but this role will be primarily focused on processing and generating Analytics from structured and unstructured datasets with the ability of parallel processing potentially in the cloud.

The ideal candidate with have a strong technology background with a demonstrated ability to quickly adapt to new technologies, a go-getter, a proven ability to work with quantitative concepts and data, and a solid understanding and experience with the investment management business.

The Team

The Vision of the team is to build a best-in-class platform for alternative data and the Mission is to provide the Right Data to the Right People at the Right Time with the Right Quality and Right Coverage.

The team is comprised of a diverse set of technology professionals including application developers, database engineers, data scientists and tool prototypers with quantitative backgrounds who work collectively with our business partners to take ideas from a whiteboard, through prototypes that garner feedback to be rapidly deployed to our users, all the way through to integration with enterprise applications in the AWS cloud.

The Expertise We’re Looking For

- Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in a technology related field (e.g. Engineering, Computer Science, etc.) required.
- 1+ years experience of enterprise development and a desire to work on a fast paced development team with the experience of handling multiple tracks concurrently.
- Strong background with object orientated programming, with projects completed leveraging many of the following technologies including Python, Java or C#
- Strong Knowledge of Data Structures and Algorithms

About Zipline

Zipline is the world’s largest and most experienced drone delivery service. We are on a mission to serve all humans equally by ensuring access to food, medicine and essential goods anytime, anywhere. We design, build, and operate the world’s largest autonomous logistics system, delivering critical supplies quickly and reliably. Today, Zipline operates on four continents, makes a delivery somewhere in the world every 30 seconds, and has completed millions of deliveries to date, including blood, vaccines, medical supplies, food, and retail products.

Our customers include the world’s largest and most prominent healthcare systems, governments, retailers, restaurants and global businesses who rely on us to save lives, reduce emissions, increase economic opportunity, and provide delivery from point A to point B as fast as possible. The drone is only 15% of what we’ve built to enable seamless, reliable, global operations.

Our system strengthens supply chains, reduces congestion, and gives people time back. With more than 140 million commercial autonomous miles safely flown, Zipline is redefining access to healthcare, consumer products, and food across the globe.

We operate at a global scale and are looking for practical problem solvers who thrive on real-world challenges and rapid growth. Our team is motivated by building systems that have a direct, meaningful impact on people’s lives and by scaling the future of logistics. We are seeking people who sculpt from first principles, enjoy facing adversity, and can do the impossible at record breaking speeds.

The Role

Every Zipline market grows differently. Customer behavior, commercial priorities, competition, partnerships, and local opportunities vary from city to city. We're looking for a Commercial Strategy & Operations Intern to help turn those local realities into clear priorities, better decisions, and measurable market growth.

You'll support the team responsible for understanding how your market is performing and where we can improve. You'll work with data, build analyses and reporting, contribute to planning, and help make sure cross-functional teams are aligned on the work that matters most. Success means helping the organization move faster, operate more effectively, and identify opportunities to improve customer, merchant, and market performance.

You'll partner closely with Commercial, Operations, Marketing, Analytics, Community Engagement, and other teams across the organization. You'll learn how a fast-growing marketplace business works while gaining hands-on experience solving ambiguous problems and translating insights into action.

What You'll Do

- Support weekly and monthly business reviews by pulling data, analyzing performance, and turning findings into clear takeaways and actions.

- Build and maintain reporting on key customer, merchant, commercial, and ops metrics.

- Analyze customer behavior, merchant performance, market trends, and operational data to identify opportunities and risks.

- Help develop business cases, forecasts, and recommendations for growth and operational initiatives.

- Partner with cross-functional teams to coordinate priorities, document decisions, track action items, and follow up on execution.

- Improve processes, templates, and operating rhythms that help teams plan and execute more effectively.

- Research competitors, local market dynamics, and emerging opportunities to inform commercial strategy.

- Prepare concise presentations and ad hoc analyses for leadership and partner teams.

- Own a defined commercial strategy or operations project from problem framing and analysis through recommendation and implementation support.

What You'll Bring

- Must have completed the second year of a bachelor's degree in business, economics, finance, data analytics, engineering, marketing, or a related field. Master’s are also eligible.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to break down complex questions and communicate the answer clearly

- Proficiency with Excel or Google Sheets; experience with SQL, dashboards, or other data tools is a plus.

- Strong attention to detail and the ability to organize multiple projects, deadlines, and stakeholders.

- Clear written and verbal communication skills, with comfort presenting findings and recommendations.

- Curiosity about how businesses grow and how strong operating practices turn strategy into results.

- A proactive, collaborative approach and willingness to take ownership in a fast-moving environment.

- Prior internship, campus leadership, project, or work experience involving analysis, operations, strategy, or cross-functional collaboration is a plus.

- Must be able to work onsite and travel frequently throughout Austin, Texas, San Antonio, Texas, Houston, Texas or Phoenix, Arizona. Requires transportation (not company provided) and the ability to independently travel to operational sites, events, communities, and partner locations as needed.

This internship is a full-time position, in-person at our Dallas, Texas, Austin, Texas, Los Angeles, California OR Phoenix, Arizona office. We will host our Summer 2027 interns (May/June - August/September). Zipline is unable to sponsor work visas for applicants to this position.
